expected_findings.summary: bump_stale_evening_to_today treats a pending record that is absent from read_pending() as answered and calls delete_entry on the linked queue entry, so once the change makes a quarantined store read as empty, a corrupt store durably deletes every confirmed escalation instead of crashing.

read_pending() swallows the decode failure and returns [], which is indistinguishable from a genuinely empty store, so every caller downstream loses the ability to tell 'no records' from 'records unreadable'.
